entries.title: Fix flaky login test
entries.criterion: The login test suite passes three runs in a row.
entries.actions:
1. shell.run (repo): Run the login suite three times
   params: {"cmd":"go test -count=3 ./auth/..."}
entries.label: approve
entries.note: The requested one-word form: a bare PASS is a pass.

entries.title: Add changelog entry
entries.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the release.
entries.actions: 1. repo.write_file (repo): Append the release entry to CHANGELOG.md
entries.label: approve
entries.reply: PASS — the plan writes the entry the criterion asks for.
entries.note: PASS first, then an explanation: the first word decides.

entries.title: Rotate staging credentials
entries.criterion: The old staging key no longer authenticates.
entries.actions:
1. vault.rotate (staging): Rotate the staging API key
2. shell.run (staging): Confirm the old key is refused
entries.label: approve
entries.note: Case does not matter: a lowercase pass is a pass.

entries.title: Bump Go toolchain
entries.criterion: The module builds with the new toolchain.
entries.actions:
1. repo.write_file (repo): Set go 1.24 in go.mod
2. shell.run (repo): go build ./...
entries.label: approve
entries.note: Approved as the first word is a positive verdict.

entries.title: Close stale issues
entries.criterion: No open issue is older than 180 days without a label.
entries.actions:
1. github.list_issues (tracker): List unlabelled issues older than 180 days
2. github.close_issue (tracker): Close each with the stale notice
entries.label: approve
entries.note: Yes as the first word is a positive verdict.

entries.title: Document the retry policy
entries.actions: 1. repo.write_file (repo): Write docs/retries.md with the backoff table
entries.label: approve
entries.reply: The criterion is met: the plan writes the backoff table to docs/retries.md.
entries.note: A discursive pass: a positive marker with no negation of it is a pass.

entries.title: Pin base image digest
entries.criterion: The Dockerfile references the base image by digest.
entries.actions: 1. repo.write_file (repo): Replace the base image tag with its sha256 digest
entries.label: approve
entries.note: Passed as the first word is a positive verdict.

entries.title: Ship the retry fix
entries.criterion: The retry fix is merged with the test suite green.
entries.actions:
1. github.open_pr (repo): Open the retry fix PR
2. github.merge_pr (repo): Merge it
entries.label: reject
entries.reply: This does not pass: the criterion is not met.
entries.note: Negated verdict: "does not pass" contains "pass" and "not met" contains "met"; neither may read as a pass.

entries.title: Migrate billing schema
entries.criterion: The billing migration has run in staging.
entries.label: reject
entries.reply: FAIL — the criterion is not met
entries.note: FAIL first decides the verdict even though the explanation contains "met".

entries.title: Delete unused buckets
entries.criterion: Only buckets with no reads in 90 days are deleted.
entries.actions: 1. cloud.delete_bucket (prod): Delete every bucket named tmp-*
entries.label: reject
entries.note: Negated verdict: "not approved" contains "approved" and must read as a fail.

entries.title: Release 2.3.0
entries.criterion: The release is tagged only after the full test suite passes.
entries.actions:
1. git.tag (repo): Tag v2.3.0
2. github.create_release (repo): Publish the release notes
entries.label: modify
entries.reply: No. The tests were never run, so the criterion is not met.
entries.note: A leading No decides the verdict even though the reply goes on to mention "met".

entries.title: Harden the upload endpoint
entries.criterion: Uploads over 10 MB are refused with 413.
entries.actions: 1. repo.write_file (repo): Add a size check to the upload handler
entries.label: modify
entries.reply: The plan does not meet the criterion; it would not pass review.
entries.note: Discursive negation: "does not" and "not pass" outweigh the "pass" substring.

entries.title: Refresh the search index
entries.criterion: The search index is rebuilt and queries return new documents.
entries.label: reject
entries.note: The requested one-word form: a bare FAIL is a fail.

entries.title: Enable audit logging
entries.criterion: Every admin action is written to the audit log.
entries.label: modify
entries.reply: Unmet: nothing in the plan covers the admin actions outside the web console.
entries.note: Unmet as the first word is a fail even though it contains "met".

entries.title: Deprecate v1 API
entries.criterion: v1 clients receive a Sunset header for 30 days before removal.
entries.label: reject
entries.reply: Rejected: removing the routes skips the 30-day sunset the criterion requires, so it would not pass.
entries.note: Rejected first decides the verdict even though the reply contains "pass".

entries.title: Backfill missing invoices
entries.criterion: Every order from March has an invoice.
entries.actions: 1. billing.backfill (prod): Generate invoices for March orders
entries.label: modify
entries.reply: There is no evidence the plan checks that the backfill covered every order, so I cannot say yes.
entries.note: Discursive negation: "no evidence" and "cannot" outweigh the "yes" substring.

entries.title: Rename the metrics prefix
entries.criterion: Dashboards keep working after the rename.
entries.actions: 1. repo.write_file (repo): Change the metrics prefix to karakuri_
entries.label: reject
entries.reply: The plan renames the metrics but doesn't update a single dashboard, so it has not met the criterion and I would not have approved it.
entries.note: Discursive negation: "doesn't" outweighs the "met" and "approved" substrings.

entries.title: Turn on dependabot
entries.criterion: Dependency update PRs are opened weekly.
entries.actions: 1. repo.write_file (repo): Add .github/dependabot.yml with a weekly schedule
entries.label: approve
entries.reply: Met — the config schedules weekly update PRs.
entries.note: Met as the first word is a positive verdict.
